BF16 and F32 tensor values are independently verified identical. The F32 fixture has an extra output.weight identical to its embedding; BF16 ties the head, so storage layout and working-set differences remain part of the file comparison.
The retained mx CLI wrapper matches llmx synthetic token histories/warm-up, unlike native llama-bench. Reinspect its source, CPU-only dispatch and library resolution before reuse on BF16.

llmx bench has fit_kv=false, identical explicit 512/128 workloads and demand-backed KV; mx reserves 512 in its own layout. Verify BF16/F32 context metadata and wrapper behavior before launching; do not claim equal logical capacities without that proof.

precision.llmx: Completed matrix-path record is f16 policy / f32 matrix arithmetic. BF16 weight bits widen exactly; original F32 matrix inputs and sums are retained. This is weight storage, not BF16 activation selection.
precision.mx: Pinned ggml/src/ggml-cpu/ggml-cpu.c:395-399 sets BF16 from_float to ggml_cpu_fp32_to_bf16, vec_dot to ggml_vec_dot_bf16 and vec_dot_type to BF16. The active ordinary matmul conversion at1351 rounds an F32 RHS to that type. The optional llamafile/sgemm.cpp:3910-3917 AVX2 BF16 path also requires Btype BF16 and computes with float accumulators. No new numeric comparison was run here.
precision.interpretation: These are the published/default runtime paths, so the throughput comparison is useful. It is not an equal-precision kernel comparison: mx BF16 dot inputs are BF16 while llmx retains F32 activations. Both use the same BF16 weight file and F16 KV.

assessment: Candidate BF16 beats pinned mx BF16 in both directions: pp +19.97/+22.74 percent and tg +6.13/+6.56 percent. This supports advancing the initial CPU screen, not declaring the complete speed gate passed.

Against the equivalent F32 fixture, BF16 trades pp -5.03/-3.46 percent for tg +93.90/+95.00 percent. Storage footprint, tied/duplicated head layout and kernel work all differ, so these are whole-model effects, not isolated conversion costs.

Q8 candidate/main pp varies +2.95/-0.76 percent and tg +0.06/-0.34 percent. No material existing-path slowdown is demonstrated by these two pairs; they do not establish exact nonregression or a small speedup.

No predeclared activity threshold is crossed. Measured host idle ranges66.44-97.75 percent and observed aggregate unrelated CPU peaks62.96 percent of one core; missing short-lived processes still limit coverage.

Production GPU activity is visible on DRM card0/PCIc3:00.0 and card7/PCI8c:00.0, not the assigned PCI03:00.0 (DRMcard8), which remains0percent busy. Numeric DRM indices are not the users rocm-smi indices.

Forward first-touch calls have more major faults (BF16291115, F32734017, mainQ8154663); reverse calls have0. F32 and mainQ8 forward block-input counts are0, so major faults alone do not establish physical disk reads. Whole-child counters cannot attribute this to timed phases.
limitations: Short-lived processes between samples may be missed; disappeared/new and inaccessible processes are retained as coverage limits. Unavailable GPU counters are not zero.
Only two observations per arm and one repetition per call; no broad speed gate or small-difference significance claim.
Whole-call activity and rusage include loading, warm-up and both phases, so they do not isolate timed prefill or decode.
Intervals bracketing adjacent calls may occur in more than one per-call total; arm counts are not globally additive.
Missing/new/departed processes are retained as unknown work, not zero. Whole-device disk counters are not summed across layered devices.
GPU ranges are descriptive; this CPU runner does not attribute production GPU work to a process. Parent announced peer build on cores8-11 and production GPU8/9 activity.
F32 fixture has an extra head exactly equal to embedding; BF16 ties its head. Storage/working-set differences are part of the file comparison.
llmx KV logical capacity and mx512 context differ; explicit token histories, F16 KV, microbatch512 and four threads match.
This screen does not prove inference identity, HF correctness, 8B performance or GPU half-weight support.
